notes.title: MAMIYA - Digital Art Book Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/ad495d31d6b25787adc3abeb9da50c692f9bf985.png[/img]To commemorate MAMIYA - Complete Collection's 1-year anniversary, a 208 page, 4k resolution art book is now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216010/MAMIYA__Digital_Art_Book/

MAMIYA - Digital Art Book includes character designs, illustrations, sketches and developer [b]Kokoroten's [/b]comments with insight into the creation process of the game! It is delivered in a .PDF format.

We hope this art book will bring you even closer to [i]MAMIYA[/i].

notes.title: MAMIYA - Complete Collection Is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/3a8713d29f0fbda625734cac27e681039eeac28e.png[/img]
After 8 years in development, the time has come! MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End has just been completed by the release of DoomsDayDreams, the final part of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591300/MAMIYA__DoomsDayDreams/

The Complete Collection is a simultaneous worldwide first release for Windows and Mac, with English and Japanese languages currently supported.

DoomsDayDreams can be purchased with a bundle discount through the MAMIYA - Complete Collection bundle!

In addition to adding the final third chapter, both FallDown and DownFall have received a massive overhaul to the latest version with revised stories, new flowcharts, branching choices and more.

The Complete Collection includes a massive 180 illustrations, and 20 endings!

Moreover, MAMIYA has been updated to support Steam achievements!

Finally, the original MAMIYA (FallDown+DownFall) release has been switched into a new "Legacy" branch, which any owners can freely switch to at any time. The saves are mutually exclusive, so there is no danger in hopping between the old and new version!

We hope you will enjoy the fruits of Kenkou Lands labor, and join the cult of MAMIYA!

[i]May it be as Our MAMIYA wills it![/i]

notes.title: Nominate MAMIYA for Labor of Love in the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/1f4338cb9bf3205c243f9d318884e00df2e172cc.png[/img]
With the release of MAMIYA - Complete Collection just around the corner, we'd like to make a short appeal for your vote in the Labor of Love category of Steam Awards!

Did you know that MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End has been in development for 8 years, and is solo developed by Kenkou Land?

Since our original release of MAMIYA, we at Fruitbat Factory have also done our best to help realize Kenkou Land's vision for the Complete Collection, which is finally about to become realized!

If you like the game, giving it your vote in the "Labor of Love" category will help boost the game's visibility on Steam, and help bring more people to the cult of MAMIYA!

We realize you only get one vote, and even if you gave it to a different game, we hope you're looking forward to MAMIYA - Complete Collection, which we're currently busy preparing for release!

notes.title: MAMIYA Demo Now Available on Mac!
notes.notes:
It's been great to see the response to all of this weekend's announcements, including the new MAMIYA demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/bf87721305819441bd01997b3d605e428ec36101.png[/img]

We have just updated the demo to support Mac as well! It's our first release on the Mac, so depending on the interest and whether we run into any unexpected issues, we're evaluating releasing the full game on Mac as well. If you try it out, don't hesitate to share your impressions with us!

notes.title: DoomsDay Dreams Release Date, New Demo!
notes.notes:
Kenkou Land's dark mystery visual novel about Boys with Problems is receiving its final chapter, DoomsDay Dreams in a worldwide premiere on November 21 (PST)! 

New key art for MAMIYA - Complete Collection has been revealed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/49ee538a5646599394cc0d4135c53c49cfacdd45.jpg[/img]

DoomsDay Dreams will be made released as a DLC to MAMIYA on Steam, and will be available through an upcoming new MAMIYA - Complete Collection bundle on Steam to new and old players alike.

[h2]MAMIYA - Complete Collection Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] An apocalyptic adventure intertwined with themes of trauma
[*] A meticulously crafted mystery scenario that rewards the observant
[*] Over 20 distinct endings of destruction and growth
[*] 180 stunning illustrations
[*] An immersive experience created through a fusion of music and storytelling
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/619e87efb8e4b867c6b47d3dfd3ac15a69faa4a0.png[/img]

Moreover, a special [b]new demo[/b] has been released at Tokyo Game Show and is now available to download from the Steam storepage, highlighting the improved new GUI and giving a taste of things to come in DoomsDay Dreams!

notes.title: Official Guidelines Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/15cda581be43aca9cf374b911f292f63a5f2dee3.png[/img]Thank you for the support we've seen for MAMIYA! 

To answer questions regarding streaming, creating fan works and otherwise engaging with the game, KENKOU LAND has released official guidelines to provide clarity.

They include permission to monetize commentated live streams / videos, as well as creation of derivative fan works. We encourage you to go over the full guidelines and restrictions laid out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1394930/discussions/0/5276582532031366169/]in this post[/url].

Please look forward to more news on the release of DoomsDay Dreams soon!

notes.title: Share an Illusion of the World’s End in MAMIYA!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/7a6a49d61626ab6e78ffe1be69557210491ed794.jpg[/img]
MAMIYA has just been released! 

6 endings await in this gorgeous dark mystery visual novel by Kenkou Land!

MAMIYA has been translated by Conjueror and Andrew Hodgson, and edited by Gerejei.  It is available in English and Japanese.

A free demo containing the full [b]FallDown side of the game[/b] can be downloaded on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394930/MAMIYA/]Steam page[/url].

[i]Can you bring salvation to this troubled group of youths before their world ends?[/i]

notes.title: Play MAMIYA Demo in Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39249105/ba50909550dc36e8ff05cec377b83fd4b9eea821.png[/img]
We're happy to announce that a playable demo for MAMIYA is now available on the Steam page!

You can download it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394930/MAMIYA/

The story of [b]MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World’s End[/b] consists of two parts: the [b]FallDown[/b] and [b]DownFall[/b] sides, and the free demo includes the entire [b]FallDown[/b] side of the game - roughly a third of the full game’s length - which contains the first routes of each of the game’s four protagonists.

If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist MAMIYA! The full game is coming out this spring.

The demo (and full game) supports English and Japanese languages. It has been translated by Conjueror and Andrew Hodgson, and edited by Gerejei.
